citation_entries.sentence: Our teachers did write on marriage, but we cannot yet give you that teaching here.
Our pastor at Geneva was a married man, and that much is a biographical fact.
No record we hold shows how ordinary people lived out their marriages.
Nor has any account reached us of how an ordinary citizen lived a day, or sat through a Sunday service.
We will not invent a wedding, or a rite for one, to fill that silence.

text: Our teachers did write on marriage, but we cannot yet give you that teaching here. Our pastor at Geneva was a married man, and that much is a biographical fact. No record we hold shows how ordinary people lived out their marriages. Nor has any account reached us of how an ordinary citizen lived a day, or sat through a Sunday service. We will not invent a wedding, or a rite for one, to fill that silence.
